summary: ACTRA’s deposit is not a full purchase. Basic is described as free permanently; included Plus and mobile-data periods are limited.

# ACTRA separates its AI pendant deposit from full payment


By OpenTools Team


Reservation and purchase include different service periods, with conflicting total‑price figures.


##


Reservation versus purchase


[ACTRA’s November 2 release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/actra-opens-early-bird-access-in-the-us-bringing-personal-ai-beyond-the-smartphone-302926588.html) offers its first 2,000 units at $199.90 full payment, alongside a $19.90 deposit. The deposit includes one month of AI Plus and 4G service; full payment includes six months.


[The release separately calls the deposit’s locked price $199](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/actra-opens-early-bird-access-in-the-us-bringing-personal-ai-beyond-the-smartphone-302926588.html) , leaving that discrepancy unresolved.


##


What remains unspecified


[The program describes AI Basic as permanently free](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/actra-opens-early-bird-access-in-the-us-bringing-personal-ai-beyond-the-smartphone-302926588.html) ; that does not extend the bundled Plus or data periods. ACTRA markets Mag 4G as a voice‑operated AI pendant with independent 4G. Free Basic is therefore a different promise from continuing mobile service.


Opening orders does not demonstrate shipment or performance. The release supplies no shipping date, refund terms or ongoing service fees.


Online‑shopping scene, May 2022; archive context, not ACTRA checkout or a product test.
